name: President's PhD Scholarships
summary: Fully funded 3.5-year PhD places at Imperial: tuition, a yearly stipend of GBP 27,036 (2027-28 rate) and a GBP 2,000 yearly consumables fund. About 50 awards for 2027-28 entry.
eligibilityNotes: No nationality restriction; UK and international candidates can apply, though some departments may be unable to support international candidates. Needs a first-class degree (or a distinction at master's) and an agreed Imperial supervisor; current Imperial PhD students are excluded. Amount shown is the yearly stipend only.
deadlineNote: Round 1 closed on 2 November 2026. Round 2 closes 11 January 2027; round 3 closes 1 March 2027 (all 23:59 UK time).

name: Warwick Chancellor's PGR Scholarships (Autumn 2027)
summary: Up to 80 PhD scholarships across several streams; the main Faculty and Interdisciplinary Chancellor's streams pay full fees, a tax-free stipend at the UKRI rate for 3.5 years and a GBP 5,000 research grant.
eligibilityNotes: Faculty, Interdisciplinary, AHRC and Pathway streams are open to any nationality or fee status. The China Scholarship Council stream is only for PRC passport holders and the Sanctuary stream needs a UK asylum-related status. Current Warwick PGR students cannot apply. Stipend amount is not stated as a figure on the page.
deadlineNote: Scholarship application deadline 10 December 2026 16:59 GMT; you must also submit the course application by 7 December 2026. Page says the call opens 5 October 2026.

name: President's Doctoral Scholar Award
summary: A four-year fully funded PhD studentship with tuition at home or international rate, a stipend and a research and skills grant of up to GBP 20,000. Eight to ten projects are funded for 2027/28.
eligibilityNotes: Open to all nationalities. Stipend is the UKRI minimum plus GBP 1,000 (GBP 22,805 in 2026/27). Needs a first or 2:1 (or equivalent). The Science and Engineering faculty page lists the 2027/28 theme as 'Sensing the World'; other faculties run their own themes, so check the project list for your field.
deadlineNote: Projects were announced 30 October 2026; application deadline 18 December 2026 on the Science and Engineering faculty page. Other faculty pages may differ.

name: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship (PhD)
summary: About 60 PhD awards for 2027/28 covering international fees, maintenance, student visa cost and the immigration health surcharge, with up to six extra months of write-up funding.
eligibilityNotes: Open to applicants from all countries except the UK and Ireland with overseas fee status, who are ranked highly by their department. Any subject except premium-rate courses. No separate form is described; the funding deadline of your course applies.
deadlineNote: The page gives no date; it follows the funding deadline of the PhD course you apply to. Check that course's deadline.

name: Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarships
summary: A first-year tuition discount of GBP 3,000, GBP 6,000 or GBP 16,000 for international students starting a Leeds bachelor's degree in September 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Open to anyone classed as an international (overseas fee) student with an offer for an eligible course and self- or part-funded. The page says fee status, not a nationality list; excluded GB is our shorthand for home-fee students. Medicine and Dentistry are excluded. Form is sent to offer holders by email.
deadlineNote: Final deadline 11 April 2027; outcomes by 10 May 2027.

name: Bath International Excellence Scholarship
summary: Up to 300 tuition discounts of GBP 8,000 per year (up to GBP 24,000 over three years) for overseas-fee students starting a Bath bachelor's degree in September 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Page gives no nationality list; eligibility depends on being assessed as an overseas fee payer, with Bath as your firm UCAS choice. The two-year MArch Architecture is excluded. Excluded GB is our shorthand for home-fee students. Considered on merit, not first come, first served.
deadlineNote: Round 1 closes 14 February 2027; round 2 closes 31 March 2027. Applications were due to open in late 2026.

name: International Excellence Award (Undergraduate)
summary: A GBP 5,000 first-year tuition fee waiver for self-funded overseas-fee students starting a full-time Surrey bachelor's degree in September 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Open to self-funded international fee-paying students of any nationality or domicile; home-fee students are not eligible (GB used as shorthand). Surrey must be your firm UCAS choice, apply before a CAS is issued, first year only, cannot be combined with other Surrey scholarships.
deadlineNote: Closes 24 August 2027 (UCAS application by 30 June 2027). Awards are reviewed monthly and given first come, first served, so apply early.

name: Vice-Chancellor's Future Leaders Award (Undergraduate)
summary: A GBP 7,500 first-year tuition fee waiver for self-funded overseas-fee students from 30 listed countries starting a Surrey bachelor's degree in September 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Expanded from the page's country list (domicile): Algeria, Botswana, Brazil, Bulgaria, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Egypt, Indonesia, Italy, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Lebanon, Mauritius, Mexico, Mongolia, Morocco, Myanmar, Nepal, Oman, Peru, Poland, Portugal, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, Uganda, Vietnam, Zimbabwe. Must be self-funded with Surrey as firm UCAS choice; not combinable with other Surrey scholarships.
deadlineNote: Closes 24 August 2027, first come, first served.

name: International Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: A needs-based tuition fee reduction, paid every year of the degree, for first-year overseas-fee entrants in 2027. The value will be confirmed by December 2026.
eligibilityNotes: For students with overseas fee status (GB used as shorthand for home-fee students). Applicants must meet at least one criterion such as financial need, previous needs-based funding, a disadvantaged area, disability or minority group. Transfers are excluded, as are William & Mary joint honours.
deadlineNote: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 27 January 2027; results week of 17 March 2027. You can apply after submitting the course application, without an offer.

name: Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship
summary: A GBP 5,000 per year tuition fee reduction for international fee-paying undergraduates, awarded in four application rounds.
eligibilityNotes: Page states no nationality requirement; it is for international fee payers (GB used as shorthand for home-fee students). The page does not state the entry year; 2027 entry is inferred from the dates.
deadlineNote: Round 1: 31 Dec 2026; round 2: 31 Mar 2027; round 3: 30 Jun 2027; round 4: 20 Aug 2027.
